children: Australian equities rose 14 points, or 0.2%, to 8,870 in early Tuesday trading, recovering from prior losses as stronger U.S. stock futures lifted sentiment.
Traders digested Apple’s earnings while awaiting the U.S. midterm elections, with a sharp drop in oil prices following renewed hopes for U.S.-Iran diplomatic talks providing further support.
However, gains were capped by caution ahead of the Reserve Bank’s interest rate decision later today, as markets widely expect a fifth rate hike this year to curb persistent price pressures.
Meanwhile, Australian home prices fell in October, extending recent drops amid affordability constraints.
Industrials, transport, and non-energy minerals led gains, offsetting losses in energy minerals, tech, and healthcare.
Qantas Airways surged 6.3% on lower fuel cost expectations, while gold miners Northern Star Resources and Evolution Mining each climbed 2.6%.
Among the big four banks, Commonwealth Bank gained 1.2%, while the other three were subdued.

title: Australian Stocks Edge Higher as Oil Prices Fall Ahead of RBA Decision
